'''Lumbridge Graveyard Teleport''' was a spell that teleported the caster to the [[Lumbridge Graveyard|graveyard]] directly south of the [[Lumbridge]] church. In order to cast this spell, players must have earned at least 60% [[Arceuus]] [[favour]] to unlock the [[Arceuus spellbook]].

The spell was replaced with the [[Arceuus Library Teleport]] in [[Update:Arceuus Spellbook Beta and A Kingdom Divided Preparation|an update]] on [[28 April]] [[2021]].
